title: Absolute Sword Sense
altTitles: เซียนสัมผัสดาบ
description: So Woonhwi was cast aside by his family after a ki rampage destroyed his dantian. He was then kidnapped by the Blood Cult and forced to live as a third-rate spy. While searching for the legendary Secret Records of the Sword Sage, he is killed and unexpectedly sent ten years into the past. Now, with his memories intact and a mysterious ability to hear the voices of swords, Woonhwi sets out to change his fate and uncover the secrets of the martial world.
author: Hanjung Wolya
